name: The soul of Amonkhet
description: The voice of the dying plane that Nissa senses, speaking of its curse and its stolen catacomb dead.

timeline.summary: In a vision Nissa hears Amonkhet's soul describe its curse and the catacombs from which Bolas took their dead.
timeline.quote: I protected the vessels to keep their souls alive and he took. . . them . . .

relations.note: Nissa concludes he corrupted the plane.
relations.quote: he warped it, perverted it, took what he liked and ruined what wasn't his.
